comparison.objective: Remove a gas can from a truck, fill it on the ground clear of the truck, then return it.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle a can and fuel nozzle in a safety-critical sequence.
comparison.success_condition: Can is upright with every base corner at least 2 cm from the truck during flow, fills after three seconds, nozzle and can are returned, and any unsafe filling permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Tests procedural safety and nozzle/can handling, not precision impact mechanics, insert protection, or loose-fragment search and recovery.
